automations.note: Runs without any connector or secret. Reads every placement in backlinks/ledger.json off the live web, records the real link attributes, commits the register to main, and opens a labelled issue when a link is lost or stops passing equity. GitHub dropped the first two scheduled windows, so the weekly Routine also calls npm run backlinks:dispatch as a fallback trigger; it only dispatches when the last run is over 26 hours old. Optional Search Console secrets widen discovery only.
